messages:
IncidentBot: P0 PAGE — possible data residency routing violation for customer AcmeCorp. Alert: 320 requests routed to eu-west-1. Policy requires us-east-1 only. Trigger: routing fallback after capacity errors. Paging @OnCall-ML :rotating_light:
OnCall-ML: ack, I'm on it. Pulling logs and config now. Who's available for a quick sync?
Alex: I'm here. I can check the routing policy and recent deploys. Saw a spike in eu-west traffic ~11:12 UTC.
Sanjay: joining. Could be the new smart-routing change from last night. I pushed a change that adjusted fallback sequencing.
Maya: security — please confirm if any customer data left permitted region. We need an immediate mitigation plan.
OnCall-ML: Sanjay/Alex, can you dump the effective routing config for AcmeCorp? Prefer CLI copy/paste.
Alex: paste:```yaml
customer: AcmeCorp
allowed_regions: [us-east-1]
routing:
  primary: us-east-1
  fallback_sequence:
    - eu-west-1
    - us-west-2
  global_fallback: true
```
Alex: note the `global_fallback: true` — that combined with fallback_sequence allowed us to route to eu-west-1 despite allowed_regions.
Sanjay: oh that's bad. We changed global_fallback to true to reduce errors during capacity pressure; didn't scope it per-tenant. My bad.
Maya: immediate mitigation: disable fallback for tenants with residency constraints OR pin AcmeCorp to primary. Which is faster?
Eva: fastest is to override AcmeCorp routing to `pin_to_region: true` or to turn off global fallback cluster-wide. Pin is safer. Running emergency policy patch:```bash
rwctl policy set AcmeCorp --pin-region us-east-1 --no-fallback
```
IncidentBot: Deploy change request submitted by Eva. Deploy job id: d-7731.
Alex: I see deploy started. Replicas in eu-west still serving current requests but new connections should be rejected after update.
OnCall-ML: Confirming: temporarily blocking new sessions in eu-west for AcmeCorp while signals stabilize.
Bartosz-Sec: also rotate any session tokens that might include region metadata? Check audit trail. We need to collect evidence for customer notification.
Sanjay: quick query: how many tokens/records may have left region? Logs show 320 requests, payloads ephemeral, nothing persisted to long-term storage buckets. KMS operations were still routed to us-east.
Maya: good — no S3 writes or DB writes in eu-west?
Alex: confirmed: no bucket writes. Only inference traffic passed through eu-west. We still need to classify as a residency violation though — routing to wrong region is a violation.
IncidentBot: Deploy d-7731 succeeded. Change applied at 11:27 UTC.
Eva: verifying routing table: AcmeCorp pinned to us-east-1, fallback disabled. Current traffic to AcmeCorp -> us-east-1 100%.
OnCall-ML: Can we replay affected requests locally to ensure no downstream persisted? Also capture headers/trace ids for compliance.
Alex: starting trace export for request ids in window 11:10-11:20 UTC. Dumping to /tmp/acme-routing-1772005123.log
Sanjay: I recommend a rollback of the global change that enabled `global_fallback: true` until we have tenant scoping in place. Rolling that back now.
IncidentBot: Rollback job r-889 queued by Sanjay.
Eva: rollback completed. Global fallback disabled. We'll open an RFC to add tenant scope enforcement to the smart-routing feature.
Maya: Customer comms: draft notice to AcmeCorp security contact explaining what happened, how many requests (320) were routed to eu-west but not persisted, actions taken, and offer logs/audit. I can draft and send after review.
OnCall-ML: Handing incident to Alex for follow-up and postmortem. I'll be available for any clarifications in the next hour.
Alex: taking it. Action items: 1) include routing policy diff in postmortem, 2) export traces and upload to secure audit folder, 3) review unit tests for tenant scoping, 4) prepare customer-facing summary. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD.
Bartosz-Sec: I'll join the postmortem. Also propose adding an automated test that simulates residency-constrained tenants hitting fallback.
Sanjay: apologies. I'll prepare a patch to ensure `global_fallback` cannot override `allowed_regions` for tenants with explicit residency.
Maya: estimated impact severity: P0 -> downgraded to P1 for operations since no data persisted, but remains security incident for compliance. Keep incident open until postmortem and customer outreach complete.
IncidentBot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" at 11:33 UTC. Root cause: mis-scoped routing fallback config applied globally.
Alex: closing notes: 320 requests misrouted, no persisted data, KMS stayed in-us, change control failure — global fallback enabled without tenant scoping. Next steps: postmortem, test coverage, policy guardrail, customer notification.
Maya: adding: log retention of exported traces in secure folder for 90 days for audit.
OnCall-ML: thanks team. I'll log incident in tracker and assign follow-ups.
Alex: resolved for now. Will ping if anything else shows up. :white_check_mark:
